channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: From Uniform to Utensils: Soldier Sakti Paul’s ₹1 Kitchen Supports 600+ People
item.description: Growing up in poverty, Sakti Paul now feeds 600 people daily and runs a free school while serving in the Assam Rifles.

item.title: India–US Trade Deal: White House Revises Factsheet Within 24 Hours, Softens Key Clauses
item.description: The US revised its India–US trade deal factsheet within a day, softening language on farm imports, digital taxes and purchase commitments after diplomatic and domestic pushback.

item.title: Cabin Crew Alleges Assault Attempt by Colleague at Gurugram Hotel; FIR Registered
item.description: Police have registered an FIR under relevant BNS sections after a cabin crew supervisor alleged her colleague attempted to sexually assault her during an overnight halt in Gurugram.

item.title: AIIMS Across India Face Acute Staff Crunch: 1 in 3 Faculty Posts Vacant, 17,205 Support Roles Unfilled
item.description: Government data reveals widespread staffing shortages across India’s AIIMS network, raising concerns over patient care, medical education quality and recruitment delays despite rapid infrastructure expansion.

item.title: Kanpur Lamborghini Crash: Shivam Mishra Arrested, Court Grants Bail Hours Later Over Legal Lapse
item.description: A Kanpur court denied police custody in the high-profile VIP Road crash, citing procedural concerns while directing the accused to cooperate with the ongoing investigation.

item.title: RBI Draft Guidelines 2026: Stricter Rules Limit Aggressive Loan Recovery Protect Borrowers’ Privacy and Dignity
item.description: The RBI’s new draft rules seek to prevent abusive loan recovery practices and ensure borrower protection.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh: Routine MRI Turns Fatal: 6-Year-Old Dies in Noida Following Alleged Anaesthesia Overdose, Probe On
item.description: A routine diagnostic scan turned fatal for six-year-old Garv Kasana in Greater Noida, leading to massive protests and a police investigation after his family alleged he was killed by an excessive dose of anaesthesia.

item.title: India Mandates 3-Hour Takedown for Deepfakes, AI Content, and Misinformation Across Social Media Platforms
item.description: From February 20, all major social media platforms in India must swiftly remove flagged harmful content, including AI-generated deepfakes and impersonation posts, or face penalties.

item.title: BCI Proposes ₹20,000 Monthly Stipend for City Lawyers, ₹15,000 for Rural Juniors; Debate Grows Over Fair Pay
item.description: The Centre has placed the BCI’s ₹20,000 urban and ₹15,000 rural minimum stipend proposal before Parliament, triggering debate over dignity, enforcement, and the financial realities faced by India’s junior lawyers.

item.title: ₹1.7 Crore Cash, 29 Raids: Lokayukta Probe Reveals Crores in Assets Linked to Senior Karnataka Officials
item.description: Simultaneous searches across Bengaluru and three districts uncovered crores in alleged disproportionate assets linked to four senior government officials.
